example.correction: Use standards-based DoH on port 443 at https://dns.quad9.net/dns-query with DNS wire format rather than application/dns-json. Quad9 retired its JSON lookup service on TCP port 5053 on May 5, 2025.

notes: Quad9 is operational and its standard DoH endpoint remains current. The entry's JSON format, application/dns-json use case, port-5053 curl example, and JSON response are obsolete. Official documentation confirms the service is free but gives no numeric quota or rate-limit policy; it asks large organizations to contact Quad9 before sending large-scale traffic.
